In an annotation-limited Gammarus analysis, target GOseq remains the
experiment-specific anchor even when no target g:Profiler context is available.
It is therefore valid to make an explicit no-target declaration for the
g:Profiler panel:

```r
run_full_echogo(
  input_dir = "gammarus_inputs",
  outdir = "gammarus_results",
  species = c(dmelanogaster = "drosophila", hsapiens = "human"),
  target_context = NA_character_,
  context_metadata = data.frame(
    context_code = c("dmelanogaster", "hsapiens"),
    context_rationale = c("Declared arthropod annotation context", "Selected broad annotation context")
  ),
  run_exploratory_default_domain = FALSE,
  run_rrvgo = TRUE,
  semantic_reference_orgdb = "org.Dm.eg.db",
  semantic_reference_role = "proxy"
)
```

The resolver/representability audit is part of the result: it reports the path
from experimental tested entities to portable names and the submitted
background. Unrepresentable entities are not evidence of absent function, and
alternative contexts do not replace better upstream annotation.

With an explicit no-target g:Profiler state, target GOseq still distinguishes
target-supported terms from `ALTERNATIVE_CONTEXT` hypotheses. The latter are
follow-up candidates with context, source-local statistic, contributing-gene,
and annotation provenance—not a claim that the reference organism experienced
the Gammarus response.

When RRvGO is enabled, `org.Dm.eg.db` is labelled as a semantic proxy for GO
similarity only. It is not an enrichment context and cannot change the
exact-term evidence table.

## What the frozen Gammarus exercises demonstrate

The two curated, frozen Gammarus exercises both retain a target GOseq anchor
and an explicit no-target g:Profiler declaration. GAM1 has 194 target GOseq
terms and 178 `TARGET_ONLY`, 16 `TARGET_PLUS_CONTEXT`, and 19
`ALTERNATIVE_CONTEXT` exact terms. GAM2 has 59 target GOseq terms and 34
`TARGET_ONLY`, 25 `TARGET_PLUS_CONTEXT`, and 20 `ALTERNATIVE_CONTEXT` exact
terms. These results demonstrate representability
and annotation limitations alongside recovery and hypothesis provenance; they
do not establish that better upstream annotation has been recreated.

For both frozen exercises, RRvGO used `org.Dm.eg.db` with the `proxy` role and
`Rel` similarity. Target-supported and alternative-context semantic products
were kept separate. The proxy describes GO semantic similarity only and never
changes term membership, source statistics, or the no-target declaration.
